body: This movie is thought provoking and make tou ponder on your purpose in life. A must see. Do not miss it
The movie takes you on a journey, that will leave a lasting impression on you. Priyanka & Farhan aced their roles, and Zarina brings justice to such a sensitive topic.

Amazing chemistry being shared by Farhan and Priyanka. What a comeback made by Priyanka Chopra after 3 long years in Bollywood, strong acting done by Priyanka and co actors like Farhan ,and zaira also acted amazingly and Rohit Saruf played his role as big brother of ziara was also good , His debut in sky is pink was a dream come true for him and his acting shows that he has a lot of potential. Not everyone will like this movie. 2nd half is a bit draggy.

This movie is amazing on so many levels. Go watch it and you wont regret it. Amazing performance from the whole cast, especially priyanka( there is a scene where her character goes through a psychotic breakdown..i cried). It will be worth every penny you spend.

This movie is based upon true events, basically upon a girl's life who's going to live for a short period and the disease is not cancer but a different one which hasn't been shown in any other movies I've watched at least. The entire film's voice over is given by that girl based upon whom it is made. I was expecting that this would be about portraying the lives of people, generally about LIFE and it was exactly as I had expected, I don't know why but somehow I like watching people's lives in the feature-length films and mostly because of the way the Bollywood films are made, I'm referring to Farhan Akhtar's sister Zoha but this was made by Shonali Bose and I was not disappointed though as it had the same feeling of watching over the reels of the lives of people living their lives from the start to the end with those more than usual timing of the character's gauging into the eyes of others which is literally like conveying the message across to the other person without even uttering a word, I was thinking that Farhan Akhtar's acting makes me feel that way but I think it is about the maker who gives such intense no-dialogue scenes that conveys something that cannot be interpreted but only is felt. I wish that Bollywood keeps giving films like these to let their industry keep running, haha.
